title: 第一卷 第25章 收获颇丰第一卷 第26章 城主和赵李两家来访
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
顾天阳微微颔首，不再多言。
一股磅礴的灵力托着他，缓缓离地而起。
灵海境修士御空飞行的异象在此刻尽显。
他白衣胜雪的身影悬浮于半空，衣袂飘飘，宛如谪仙。
下方的顾家子弟们见状，纷纷停下手中的动作，仰头望去，眼中充满了崇拜。
这便是灵海境强者的威能。
摆脱大地束缚，御空而行，这是他们梦寐以求的境界。
顾天阳低头看了一眼下方的族人，嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的笑容。
随即身形一动，化作一道流光，朝着顾家的方向疾驰而去。
御空飞行的速度极快，不过短短片刻，顾家便出现在视野之中。
顾天阳收敛周身灵力，缓步朝着自己的大厅走去。
刚踏入大厅，一股淡淡的茶香便扑面而来，令人心旷神怡。
厅内，李清月、苏灵、苏韵三女正端坐在一侧。
见顾天阳归来，连忙起身行礼。
“公子！”
顾天阳抬手示意她们免礼，走到主位坐下。
李清月上前，为他斟上一杯灵茶，动作轻柔娴熟。
苏灵和苏韵则侍立在旁，并未多言。
此次出征王家，顾天阳并未让三女随行。
她们三人刚刚激**质，修为尚浅，当务之急是稳固境界，而非参与这种血腥厮杀。

对于顾天阳的安排，三女心中毫无怨言，她们也知道自身实力不足。
唯有潜心修炼，才能不辜负公子的栽培，未来也能为公子出一份力。
顾天阳端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口。
他放下茶杯，目光落在三女身上，语气温和。
“此次灭王家，你们并未随行，想必心中多少有些好奇。”
苏灵性子最为活泼，闻言忍不住点头，大眼睛里满是好奇。
“公子，战斗是否很凶险？”
顾天阳淡淡一笑，语气带着一丝不屑。
“不堪一击！”
随即，他简要叙述了战斗的过程。
从王家上门退婚，到玄尘道人出手施压，再到他出手。
最后血洗王家，整个过程娓娓道来，轻描淡写，仿佛只是做了一件微不足道的小事。
三女听到顾天阳仅用两招便重创王腾和废掉灵海境的玄尘道人时，眼中满是震撼。
“公子神威！”
三女齐声说道，语气中充满了由衷的敬佩。
顾天阳摆了摆手，话锋一转。
“此次不让你们随行，并非不信你们的实力，而是你们当前的首要任务是修炼。”
他心念一动，几个玉瓶出现在手中，分别递给三女。
“这是给你们的修炼资源。”
三女接过玉瓶，打开一看，眼中瞬间爆发出璀璨的光芒。

李清月手中的几个玉瓶，分别放着30颗极品聚气丹、10颗极品破境丹，还有50颗极品凝气丹。
content_en:
Gu Tianyang nodded slightly and said no more.
A majestic spiritual power held him up, slowly rising from the ground.
The vision of the monks in the spiritual sea realm flying in the air was fully revealed at this moment.
His figure in white clothes was suspended in the air, his clothes and sleeves fluttering, like an immortal.
Seeing this, the children of the Gu family below stopped what they were doing and looked up, their eyes filled with admiration.
This is the power of a strong person in the spiritual sea realm.
To get rid of the shackles of the earth and fly in the air, this is the realm they dream of.
Gu Tianyang lowered his head and glanced at the tribesmen below, with a faint smile on his lips.
Immediately, his body moved and turned into a stream of light, speeding towards the direction of the Gu family.
Yukong flew extremely fast, but in just a short moment, the Gu family appeared in sight.
Gu Tianyang gathered his spiritual power and walked slowly towards his hall.
As soon as I stepped into the hall, a faint scent of tea hit my face, which was refreshing.
In the hall, three girls, Li Qingyue, Su Ling and Su Yun, were sitting on one side.
Seeing Gu Tianyang return, he quickly stood up and saluted.
"Master!"
Gu Tianyang raised his hand to signal them to excuse themselves, walked to the main seat and sat down.
Li Qingyue stepped forward and poured him a cup of spiritual tea with gentle and skillful movements.
Su Ling and Su Yun stood by and didn't say much.
During this expedition to the Wang family, Gu Tianyang did not let the three girls accompany him.
The three of them have just aroused their temperament and their cultivation is still shallow. The top priority is to stabilize their realm rather than participate in this bloody fight.
Regarding Gu Tianyang's arrangement, the three women had no complaints in their hearts, and they also knew that their own strength was insufficient.
Only by concentrating on cultivation can we live up to the cultivation of the young master and be able to contribute to the young master in the future.
Gu Tianyang picked up the teacup and took a sip.
He put down the teacup, his eyes fell on the three women, and his tone was gentle.
"You did not accompany the Wang family this time, so you must be somewhat curious."
Su Lingzi was the liveliest one. He couldn't help but nod when he heard the words, his big eyes full of curiosity.
"Sir, is the battle dangerous?"
Gu Tianyang smiled faintly, with a hint of disdain in his tone.
"Vulnerable!"
Then he briefly described the battle.
From the time the Wang family came to break off the engagement, to Taoist Xuanchen putting pressure on her, and then to him taking action.
In the end, the bloodbath of the Wang family was told in a eloquent and understated way, as if it was just a trivial thing.
When the three girls heard that Gu Tianyang used only two moves to severely injure Wang Teng and Taoist Xuanchen who had destroyed the spiritual sea realm, their eyes were full of shock.
"Master's power!"
The three women said in unison, their voices full of sincere admiration.
Gu Tianyang waved his hand and changed the subject.
"The reason why I won't let you accompany me this time is not because I don't believe in your strength, but because your current priority is cultivation."
With a thought in his mind, several jade bottles appeared in his hands and were handed to the three women respectively.
"This is a training resource for you."
The three women took the jade bottle and opened it, their eyes instantly burst into bright light.
The jade bottles in Li Qingyue's hand contained 30 top-grade Qi Gathering Pills, 10 top-grade Breaking Realm Pills, and 50 top-grade Qi Condensation Pills.
